steps.title: Create the sprint with start plus end dates in Jira
sop: Open the team's project in Jira and select the Backlog view of the Scrum board
Click Create sprint above the backlog list
Open the new sprint's actions menu and choose Edit sprint
Enter the sprint name, set the start date, then set the end date exactly 2 weeks later and save
Done when the board shows the sprint header with its start and end dates
verify: Open the Scrum board in Jira and locate the sprint on the Backlog view
Open Edit sprint and read the start and end dates
Pass when the sprint exists and the dates span exactly 2 weeks

steps.title: Enter the sprint goal in Jira
sop: Open the Backlog view of the team's Scrum board in Jira
Open the sprint's actions menu and choose Edit sprint
Type the sprint goal into the Sprint goal field and save
Done when the goal text appears under the sprint name on the board
verify: Open the sprint header on the Scrum board in Jira
Pass when the Sprint goal field shows a non-empty goal

steps.title: Commit only stories meeting the Definition of Ready to the sprint in Jira
sop: Open the team's Definition of Ready page in Confluence for reference
Open the Backlog view in Jira and review each candidate story against the Definition of Ready
Drag each story that meets the definition from the backlog into the sprint
Leave every story that fails any Definition of Ready item in the backlog
Done when every story inside the sprint meets the Definition of Ready
verify: Open the sprint in Jira and list the committed stories
Check each committed story against the Definition of Ready page
Pass when zero committed stories fail the definition

steps.title: Return each not-ready story to the backlog with a Not Ready label in Jira
sop: Open each story that failed the Definition of Ready in Jira
Drag the story out of the sprint back into the backlog
Add the label not-ready on the story's detail panel
Add a comment naming the missing Definition of Ready item
Done when no not-ready story remains inside the sprint
verify: Run the backlog filter label equals not-ready in Jira
Open each returned story and read its reason comment
Pass when every returned story carries the label and a reason note

steps.title: Set an assigned owner on every committed story in Jira
sop: Open the sprint's story list on the Scrum board in Jira
Open each committed story and set the Assignee field to the engineer taking it
Confirm each named assignee accepted the story during planning
Done when no committed story shows Unassigned
verify: Filter the sprint by empty Assignee in Jira
Pass when the filter returns zero committed stories

steps.title: Reconcile committed points to the 3-sprint average velocity in Jira
sop: Open the Velocity report under the board's Reports tab in Jira
Average the completed points of the last 3 sprints
Sum the story points committed to the new sprint on the Backlog view
Adjust scope with the Product Owner until the committed total sits within 15% of the average
Done when committed points sit within 15% of the 3-sprint average
verify: Open the Velocity report in Jira and recompute the 3-sprint average
Sum the committed estimates shown on the sprint header
Pass when the committed total is within 15% of the average

steps.title: Link the delivery repository to the sprint board in Jira
sop: Open Project settings in Jira and select the Development tools section
Connect the delivery repository from GitHub Enterprise
Open a committed story and expand its Development panel to confirm the link resolves
Done when committed stories show the repository in the Development panel
verify: Open a committed story in Jira and expand the Development panel
Pass when the linked repository resolves for committed work

steps.title: Record the sprint commitment in PPM tool (Clarity/Planview/Jira Align)
sop: Open the team's plan in PPM tool (Clarity/Planview/Jira Align)
Open the current increment and select the new sprint row
Enter the committed story points and the sprint goal
Save the entry so the commitment is visible to the portfolio
Done when the saved sprint entry shows the commitment
verify: Open the team plan in PPM tool (Clarity/Planview/Jira Align)
Pass when the sprint entry shows the saved commitment

steps.title: Publish the sprint planning minutes on the team sprint page in Confluence
sop: Open the team space in Confluence and create a page from the sprint planning template
Record the goal, the committed stories and the capacity notes
Publish the page under the team's sprint pages parent
Done when the published page carries the sprint-start date stamp
verify: Open the team's sprint page in Confluence
Pass when the minutes show the commitment with a publish timestamp

steps.title: Start the sprint in Jira
sop: Open the Backlog view of the Scrum board in Jira
Confirm the goal is set and at least one story is committed
Click Start sprint and confirm the dates in the dialog
Done when the board switches to the active Sprint view
verify: Open the Scrum board in Jira and read the sprint state
Pass when the sprint reads active with the recorded dates

steps.title: Record the Product Owner sign-off on the sprint commitment in Jira
sop: Open the sprint in Jira after planning ends
Review the committed stories against the agreed goal
Add an approval comment on the sprint recording the sign-off
Done when the approval comment is visible with zero not-ready stories committed
verify: Open the sprint report in Jira and read the comments
Pass when the Product Owner approval comment is present
